events.title: Gobs & Gears Built for Steam Deck!
events.summary: Your Gobs are ready to travel. Gobs & Gears runs on our own custom engine, built from scratch with one goal in mind. Run well everywhere, including the Steam Deck in your hands! Here's what that means on Deck: Made for performance. No heavyweight engine underneath, just the game. It boots fast and keeps your loot routes moving smoothly even when your goblin operation gets out of hand. Scaled for the Deck's screen. events.title: Gobs & Gears Demo out NOW!
events.summary: The Gobs & Gears demo is live. Go get it. The Gob King wants his bomb. He wanted it five minutes ago. The factory that could build it is lost somewhere out in the Fog. Push out through the Fog. Find the factory buildings the Gobs misplaced. Wire them back together one Trundler at a time.Lay routes: Conveyors haul Resources from Building to Building. You draw the lines.Reveal the map: Scout Towers punch holes in the Fog. Lost Buildings are out there.Reclaim what's dead: Route the right Resources
